name: alert-dialog-destructive
title: Alert Dialog destructive
description: Deleting a project, with an icon and a destructive action that runs before the dialog closes.

files.content:
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogMedia, AlertDialogOverlay, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialog, AlertDialogPortal, AlertDialogTrigger, } from '@/ui/alert-dialog/alert-dialog'; import { Button } from '@/ui/button/button'; /** * Deleting a project: an icon, a destructive action whose handler runs * before the dialog closes, and the result reported on the page. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-alert-dialog-destructive', imports: [ AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogMedia, AlertDialogOverlay, AlertDialogTitle, Button, AlertDialog, AlertDialogPortal, AlertDialogTrigger, NdIcon, ], template: `

Delete "Website redesign"?

Its 24 tasks and their comments are deleted for everyone. This can't be undone.

@if (deleted()) { Project deleted. }

`, }) export class AlertDialogDestructiveExample { protected readonly deleted = signal(false); }
